profile.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 8.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

implementation: One shared data-only Node/Python capture producer preserves native Blender evaluated geometry and source material graphs; it does not convert to the current rigid glTF subset.

Strict bounded job contract requires complete absolute manual controls, declared finite ranges, owned frame paths and captured file hashes. Fixed child Node admission is released on parse/filesystem/process errors, preserving foreign owners.

Frozen worker/job identities, immutable source hash, actual Blender build/engine/color, native evaluated part streams/matrices/bounds and successful render count are retained. Blender is a host executable separate from asset content.

Public candidate engine exports include captureBlenderAsset, job schema/parser/types and limits. Full Python lint/format commands include the worker; package runtime-asset copying includes Python source. No new composition .blend format, automatic rig/shader transfer or whole QA acceptance is claimed.

probe.method: Evaluated mesh/control discovery only; not contact, surface visibility, full action or episode qualification. Editorial section prefixes were corrected in derived analysis without rewriting original probe; triangle-index differences do not prove polygon-connectivity changes.

receiver.sourceClock: four data-only states, 30fps; no narration/episode timing
receiver.scope: Real native zipper control capture to Still Shift sequence/text load-save-reload/lossless PNG export. No transferred mesh rig, whole source facts/contact/continuous/listening or narrated pilot acceptance.

retainedFailures.reason: Blender background startup crashes before the script. Identical read-only command with host execution succeeds; no host approval denial occurred.

Union isinstance and long scope-string formatting errors are corrected; initial TypeScript builds remain their own successful checks. Python lint success is not inferred from the following shell command exit.
Private fixture supplied unsupported font asset family field; strict schema rejects before export.

H.264 decoded pixels outside edited text are not byte-identical due to lossy coding; the strict byte assertion fails. Original outputs retained; no source-image corruption inferred. Lossless PNG verification follows separately.

remaining: Integrate generic native capture observations and cache/report/QA contracts with all ten actual episodes, cue/control/camera planning and whole supplied Alden recordings.
Actual channel first-ten production/broader coverage and whole factual/design/mechanical/encoded/continuous/listening reviews; zipper prototype does not count as a narrated accepted pilot episode.
Broader original seeded fault/capability/paired metrics and final full/benchmark/archive/checksum/isolated-installed requirements.
qualification: Shared native capture foundation and actual full zipper content/receiver prototype. Editable native source/controls stay in Blender; receiving scope is cached sequence/text. No reduced model, transferred editable mesh rig, all-ten production, whole review or public package adoption is claimed.
